Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.test
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.test

Class LanguageTestContexts

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.test.LanguageTestContexts
public final class LanguageTestContexts extends Object
Creates the contexts the engine passes to an expression language, for unit tests of a language's compiler and compiled expressions. The context interfaces are sealed, so a test can't implement them. These are the engine's own implementations, and behave as they do in a run: for example, writing to the facts fails with the engine's message.

To check a language against everything the engine promises for its rules, extend ExpressionLanguageContractTest.

    • compile

      public static CompileContext compile(Set<String> packageImports, Set<Class<?>> classImports, ClassLoader classLoader, Class<?> outputType, Map<String,String> options, Map<String,Class<?>> declaredFacts, boolean allFactsDeclared)
      Creates a compile context for an engine that was told which facts its rules use, so a language's tests can check what it makes of the declarations.
      Parameters:
      packageImports - The imported packages, such as java.util; copied
      classImports - The classes imported one by one; copied
      classLoader - The class loader to look up classes in the imported packages with
      outputType - The type of the output object, as the engine's builder was told; Object.class when it wasn't
      options - The language's options, as the engine's builder was given them; copied
      declaredFacts - The declared type of each fact, by name, as the engine's builder was told; copied
      allFactsDeclared - Whether a run may supply only the declared facts, as RulesEngineBuilder.requireDeclaredFacts() says
      Returns:
      The context. A fact declared with a primitive type is given as its wrapper, as an engine gives it.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument, or an element of a set, of the options or of the declarations, is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a fact is declared with the name output, which an engine rejects too

    • evaluation

      public static EvaluationContext evaluation(Map<String,? extends @Nullable Object> facts, @Nullable Instant deadline)
      Creates the context a condition is evaluated against, for a run with a deadline.
      Parameters:
      facts - The facts by name, whose values can be null; copied
      deadline - When the run must stop, or null if it has none, as an engine built without runTimeout gives it
      Returns:
      The context. Its EvaluationContext.isCancelled() answers as it does in a run: true once the deadline has passed, or while the calling thread's interrupt status is set.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if facts is null
